name: pats-android
description: PATS Android APP：把網頁前端打包進 APK，資料仍由 Apps Script 雲端提供

scripts.sync: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
